items.title: Union Pacific Has Raised Its Dividend for 20 Years. These 3 Railroads Offer Income
items.summary: Three railroads sit on networks no rival could ever rebuild, yet their yields look thin and one dividend has not budged in years. A pending merger and a regulator's pending ruling could decide which payout deserves a spot in your income plan.

items.title: What Does Union Pacific (UNP) Owe After The Teamsters Arbitration Ruling?
items.summary: Union Pacific (NYSE:UNP) has been ordered to pay a multimillion dollar arbitration award to the BLET Teamsters union. The ruling centers on Union Pacific’s failure to implement a negotiated work schedule benefit for locomotive engineers. Arbitrators directed the railroad to compensate affected workers after confirming the schedule benefit had not been put in place as agreed. The multimillion dollar BLET Teamsters arbitration win against Union Pacific is one factor to weigh against the rest...

items.title: Trump Officials Met Privately With Hedge Funds on Mega Rail Deal
items.summary: In a highly unusual gathering, White House officials met privately this week with a group of hedge fund investors betting on whether the $72 billion tie-up between Union Pacific Corp. and Norfolk Southern Corp. will win approval from the Trump administration, according to people familiar with the matter.
